intro.h2: Take pride in your home, hire someone who takes pride in the work
paragraphs: Forney Home Services handles bathroom remodeling Mt. Juliet families trust for the big jobs and the small ones. Owner Scott Forney has turned old jetted tubs into marble-look tile showers, built custom vanities and laid new tile and LVP floors in homes around town.

Customers keep coming back. One homeowner has used Scott for projects large and small for three years and says he works quickly at a reasonable price. Others called him for a rental property repair and for ice storm damage, and say the repaired areas show no trace of it. On time, professional and affordable is how reviewers sum him up.

items.name: Bathroom remodels
items.blurb: Full bathroom remodels, including tearing out an old jetted tub and replacing it with a tiled shower. Recent bathrooms feature marble-look wall tile, mosaic accent bands, hexagon shower floors, new lighting and glass doors, finished with clean trim and paint.

image.alt: Before and after: old jetted tub with dated tile replaced by a shower with large white marble-look wall tile

items.name: Custom vanities and tops
items.blurb: Scott builds custom vanities and updates existing ones with new paint, granite tops and fresh hardware. One before and after shows a bright blue vanity changed to dark cabinets with a granite top and undermount sinks.

image.alt: Before and after: blue bathroom vanity updated to dark cabinets with a gray granite top and two undermount sinks

items.name: Tile and flooring
items.blurb: Tile floors, tile showers and LVP flooring through bedrooms, living areas and baths. Google lists four reviews for laminate floor installation, and Facebook posts show large plank tile and wood-look floors running from room to room.

image.alt: New large-format light plank tile floor in a bathroom next to a dark wood door

items.name: Kitchen updates
items.blurb: Kitchen remodeling is part of the work too. One kitchen received white shaker cabinets, a white countertop with an undermount sink and a gray herringbone tile backsplash around the window. Ask Scott about cabinets, counters and tile for your kitchen.

image.alt: White shaker kitchen cabinets with white countertop, undermount sink and gray herringbone tile backsplash

items.name: Repairs, additions and storm damage
items.blurb: Water damage and ceiling repairs, ice storm repairs, rental maintenance, deck repair and staining, water lines, beams and even a home addition and a garage roof rebuild after a past owner cut the trusses. Scott also fixes what earlier owners got wrong.

image.alt: Finished room with dark plank flooring, gray walls, vaulted ceiling and ceiling fan

about.text: Forney Home Services is Scott Forney's business in Mt. Juliet, Tennessee. On Facebook the company puts its approach simply: you are proud of your home, so why not hire someone who will take pride in their work? Scott and his team take on everything from bathroom remodels and custom vanity builds to LVP floors, deck staining, water lines and a full home addition. He posts his projects when he can, often admitting he has been too busy working to share pictures. Customers describe him as professional, affordable and always on time.

image.alt: Remodeled bathroom and laundry with walnut double vanity, arched mirrors, brass fixtures, freestanding tub and light tile floor

steps.title: Reach out
steps.text: Call (872) 248-4243 Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM, or email forneyhs@gmail.com with photos of the room or the damage.

steps.title: Look at the problem
steps.text: Scott and his team come out, look at the space and talk through what needs fixing or remodeling and what you want it to look like.

steps.title: Do the work
steps.text: The team works quickly and shows up on time, from tear-out through tile, vanities, floors and trim.

steps.title: Clean up and walk through
steps.text: The work area is cleaned before they leave, and you look over the finished project together so nothing is missed.

service_area.h2: Bathroom remodeling Mt. Juliet and nearby
service_area.text: Forney Home Services is based at 2401 S Mt Juliet Rd in Mt. Juliet, Tennessee, and its Facebook projects are posted from Mt. Juliet. Scott works on owner-occupied homes and rental properties around town, from small repairs to full bathroom remodels. If you live nearby and are not sure you are in range, call (872) 248-4243 and ask Scott directly.

items.q: Do you take small jobs or only big remodels?
items.a: Both. John has hired Forney Home Services for projects large and small over three years, and Dee called Scott for a maintenance issue at a rental home. Tiffini plans to call again for projects big and small. Call and describe your job, whatever the size.

items.q: Can you fix water or storm damage?
items.a: Yes. Google lists three reviews for water damage repair and two for ceiling repair. After an ice storm, one customer said Scott's team solved the problem immediately and the repaired areas show no trace of the damage. Send photos so Scott can see what happened.

items.q: What bathroom work do you do?
items.a: Full bathroom remodels, tile showers, custom vanity builds, vanity updates with granite tops, tile and LVP floors, lighting and fixtures. One project replaced an old jetted tub with a marble-look tile shower and a mosaic band. Call to talk about your bathroom and what you want changed.

Forney Home Services is open Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM and closed on Saturday and Sunday. Call (872) 248-4243 during those hours, or email forneyhs@gmail.com with photos and a description of your project any time, and Scott will get back to you.

items.q: Do you work on rental properties?
items.a: Yes. Dee reached out to Scott for help with a maintenance issue at a rental home and said he was quick, efficient and very helpful. Landlords can call (872) 248-4243 to describe the problem and arrange a time for the team to come out.

final_cta.h2: Ready to fix up your bathroom?
final_cta.text: Call Scott to talk about your remodel or repair.
